anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only the anodes of D4, D14, and D23. It is not connected to any power source or driver.
anomalies.expected: The anodes should be connected to a 3.3V power source (e.g., +3V3 or a switched 3.3V rail) to allow the LEDs to illuminate.
anomalies.impact: The Ethernet LEDs (D14, D23) and the activity LED (D4) will never light up because their anodes are floating.

anomalies.observed: SW6 is a 2x SPST DIP switch. Switch 1 (pins 1-2) connects R34.2 to R35.2. Switch 2 (pins 3-4) connects /CAN1_P to /CAN0_P. R34.1 is on /CAN0_N, R35.1 is on /CAN1_N.
anomalies.expected: R34 should connect between /CAN0_N and /CAN0_P via one switch; R35 should connect between /CAN1_N and /CAN1_P via the other switch. The two CAN buses should remain separate.
anomalies.impact: Closing the DIP switches will short CAN0_P to CAN1_P and connect the two termination resistors between CAN0_N and CAN1_N, bridging the two isolated CAN buses and causing bus contention.

anomalies.observed: R28 has value "10" but its MPN is 0603WAF1002T5E, which is a 10kΩ resistor. It is used as a pull-up on SCL0_GPIO45.
anomalies.expected: R28 should be 10kΩ to match the MPN and the companion pull-up R23 (10K) on SDA0_GPIO44.
